Introduction
This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection I1 on discharger 
 resistor cabinet for 
 battery, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
 the title block.
This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
karam, accepted by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, and approved by eng. 
Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah: head sector of Damanhour Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy: WDEPC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A 
work permit must be issued.
The qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.
A 
work permit must be issued.
The qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.
Isolate the rectifier/charger 
 out of service and earth.
The presence 
 of current in load is signaled by flashing caution lamp and a display segment

and Equipment

Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
